answer: Hey! I'm Mark, a software developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. I build full-stack products with a strong focus on fintech and AI. Currently the founder of EaziWage — an earned wage access platform serving employees and employers across East Africa.

EaziWage is a fintech earned wage access platform I founded, targeting Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwanda. It lets employees access their earned wages before payday — zero interest, zero loans. Employers get a retention and productivity tool at no cash cost. Built on Next.js, Supabase, and integrated with mobile money rails like M-PESA and MTN MoMo.

My core stack is Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase. For animations I use Framer Motion and GSAP. I also work with Python, SQL, and have experience integrating third-party APIs like Dusupay, Pusher, and the Anthropic Claude API. I use WindSurf, Kilo Code, and Gemini CLI as AI coding tools.

Wiza is EaziWage's AI-powered financial coaching assistant, built using the Anthropic Claude API. It gives employees personalized financial guidance based on their wage and advance history. It's one of my favorite features I've shipped — an AI that actually knows your financial context, not just generic advice.

I'm a self-driven full-stack developer with hands-on experience building production fintech products. My background spans frontend (React, Next.js), backend (Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL), and AI integrations. I believe in learning by building real things rather than just following tutorials.

I'm selectively open to interesting opportunities — especially in fintech, AI, or products that matter. If you're building something meaningful, let's talk. Reach out via email or LinkedIn and I'll get back to you.
